// Generated from Moru UI source. Do not edit. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
/** Preview states share the same visual rules as actual pointer and keyboard states. */
export type UIState = 'default' | 'hover' | 'pressed' | 'focus' | 'disabled' | 'error' | 'loading'

export const uiStateOptions: ReadonlyArray<{ value: UIState; label: string; description: string }> =
  [
    { value: 'default', label: '기본', description: '아직 조작하지 않은 상태' },
    { value: 'hover', label: '호버', description: '포인터를 올린 상태' },
    { value: 'pressed', label: '누름', description: '컨트롤을 누르고 있는 상태' },
    { value: 'focus', label: '포커스', description: '키보드로 선택한 상태' },
    { value: 'disabled', label: '비활성', description: '현재 사용할 수 없는 상태' },
    { value: 'error', label: '오류', description: '내용을 확인하거나 다시 시도해야 하는 상태' },
    { value: 'loading', label: '로딩', description: '작업을 처리하는 동안 기다리는 상태' },
  ]

export { semanticToneOptions, type SemanticTone } from './_theme/tokens'

/* Generated from Moru UI source. Do not edit. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT */
/* Material recipes resolve independently in every ThemeScope and portal.
 * Neutral variables preserve Default; no ancestor pack selector leaks through a
 * nested Default scope. Fields retain opaque fills and their focus/error UI.
 */
:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
  .ui-card.ui-card,
  .ui-dialog.ui-dialog,
  .ui-toast.ui-toast,
  .ui-command.ui-command,
  .ui-menu.ui-menu,
  .ui-popover.ui-popover,
  .ui-select-popup.ui-select-popup,
  .ui-combobox-popup.ui-combobox-popup,
  .ui-alert-dialog.ui-alert-dialog,
  .ui-sheet.ui-sheet,
  .ui-drawer.ui-drawer,
  .ui-navigation-popup.ui-navigation-popup,
  .ui-hover-card.ui-hover-card,
  .ui-sidebar-mobile-panel.ui-sidebar-mobile-panel,
  .ui-sidebar.ui-sidebar,
  .ui-calendar.ui-calendar,
  .ui-code-block.ui-code-block,
  .ui-collapsible.ui-collapsible,
  .ui-scroll-area.ui-scroll-area,
  .ui-resizable-group.ui-resizable-group,
  .ui-table-scroll.ui-table-scroll,
  .ui-message-scroller.ui-message-scroller,
  .ui-attachment.ui-attachment,
  .ui-header.ui-header,
  .ui-footer.ui-footer
):where(:not([data-variant='transparent'], [data-variant='ghost'], [data-variant='minimal'])) {
  background-image: var(--ui-pack-surface-image, none);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--ui-pack-surface-filter, none);
  backdrop-filter: var(--ui-pack-surface-filter, none);
}

:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
    .ui-card.ui-card,
    .ui-dialog.ui-dialog,
    .ui-toast.ui-toast,
    .ui-command.ui-command,
    .ui-menu.ui-menu,
    .ui-popover.ui-popover,
    .ui-select-popup.ui-select-popup,
    .ui-combobox-popup.ui-combobox-popup,
    .ui-alert-dialog.ui-alert-dialog,
    .ui-sheet.ui-sheet,
    .ui-drawer.ui-drawer,
    .ui-navigation-popup.ui-navigation-popup,
    .ui-hover-card.ui-hover-card,
    .ui-sidebar-mobile-panel.ui-sidebar-mobile-panel,
    .ui-sidebar.ui-sidebar,
    .ui-calendar.ui-calendar,
    .ui-code-block.ui-code-block,
    .ui-collapsible.ui-collapsible,
    .ui-scroll-area.ui-scroll-area,
    .ui-resizable-group.ui-resizable-group,
    .ui-table-scroll.ui-table-scroll,
    .ui-message-scroller.ui-message-scroller,
    .ui-attachment.ui-attachment,
    .ui-header.ui-header,
    .ui-footer.ui-footer
  ):where(
    :not([data-variant='transparent'], [data-variant='ghost'], [data-variant='minimal'])
  ):where(:not(.ui-header[data-variant='app'])) {
  background-color: var(--ui-pack-surface-bg, var(--ui-surface, #fff));
}

/* The app Header deliberately retains its control fill instead of the surface. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-header.ui-header[data-variant='app'] {
  background-image: var(--ui-pack-surface-image, none);
}

:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
  .ui-card.ui-card,
  .ui-dialog.ui-dialog,
  .ui-toast.ui-toast,
  .ui-command.ui-command,
  .ui-menu.ui-menu,
  .ui-popover.ui-popover,
  .ui-select-popup.ui-select-popup,
  .ui-combobox-popup.ui-combobox-popup,
  .ui-alert-dialog.ui-alert-dialog,
  .ui-sheet.ui-sheet,
  .ui-drawer.ui-drawer,
  .ui-navigation-popup.ui-navigation-popup,
  .ui-hover-card.ui-hover-card,
  .ui-sidebar-mobile-panel.ui-sidebar-mobile-panel
):where(:not([data-variant='transparent'], [data-variant='ghost'], [data-variant='minimal'])) {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-surface-shadow, var(--ui-shadow, none));
}

/* Flat surfaces, including the desktop sidebar, keep Default free of elevation. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
  .ui-sidebar.ui-sidebar,
  .ui-calendar.ui-calendar,
  .ui-code-block.ui-code-block,
  .ui-collapsible.ui-collapsible,
  .ui-scroll-area.ui-scroll-area,
  .ui-resizable-group.ui-resizable-group,
  .ui-table-scroll.ui-table-scroll,
  .ui-message-scroller.ui-message-scroller,
  .ui-attachment.ui-attachment,
  .ui-header.ui-header,
  .ui-footer.ui-footer
):where(:not([data-variant='transparent'], [data-variant='ghost'], [data-variant='minimal'])) {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-sidebar-shadow, none);
}

/* Paint only the field's focus owner. Disabled addons do not disable an editable
 * group; inner inputs never get a second rim. OTP retains its active-slot marker.
 */
:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
  .ui-input.ui-input,
  .ui-textarea.ui-textarea,
  .ui-select.ui-select,
  .ui-native-select.ui-native-select,
  .ui-date-picker-trigger.ui-date-picker-trigger,
  .ui-input-group.ui-input-group,
  .ui-combobox.ui-combobox,
  .ui-number-input-group.ui-number-input-group,
  .ui-multi-select.ui-multi-select,
  .ui-time-picker-control.ui-time-picker-control,
  .ui-checkbox.ui-checkbox,
  .ui-radio.ui-radio,
  .ui-switch.ui-switch,
  .ui-file-input input[type='file'],
  .ui-button.ui-button:where([data-variant='secondary']),
  .ui-toggle.ui-toggle:where(:not([data-pressed])),
  .ui-slider:where(:not([data-disabled], [aria-invalid='true'])) .ui-slider-thumb
):where(
  :not(
    :disabled,
    [data-disabled],
    [aria-disabled='true'],
    [aria-invalid='true'],
    [aria-busy='true'],
    [data-invalid],
    [data-loading],
    [data-ui-state='error'],
    [data-ui-state='disabled'],
    [data-ui-state='loading'],
    .ui-input-group-input,
    .ui-input-group-textarea,
    .ui-combobox-input,
    .ui-enhanced-input-field,
    .ui-time-picker-input
  ):not(
    :has(
      :is(input, textarea, select):is(
        :disabled,
        [aria-disabled='true'],
        [aria-invalid='true'],
        [aria-busy='true'],
        [data-loading],
        [data-ui-state='error'],
        [data-ui-state='disabled'],
        [data-ui-state='loading']
      )
    )
  )
) {
  background-image: var(--ui-pack-control-image, none);
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-control-shadow, none);
}

/* Grouping rails retain their own opaque fill and do not gain a second blur. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(.ui-tabs-list.ui-tabs-list, .ui-toggle-group.ui-toggle-group, .ui-menubar.ui-menubar):where(
  :not([data-disabled], [aria-disabled='true'])
) {
  background-image: var(--ui-pack-control-image, none);
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-highlight-shadow, none);
}

/* Small filled surfaces share the control material, not the state of their children. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
  .ui-kbd.ui-kbd,
  .ui-item.ui-item:where([data-variant='muted']),
  .ui-context-menu-trigger.ui-context-menu-trigger,
  .ui-sidebar-mobile-trigger.ui-sidebar-mobile-trigger
):where(:not(:disabled, [data-disabled], [aria-disabled='true'], [aria-invalid='true'])) {
  background-image: var(--ui-pack-control-image, none);
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-control-shadow, none);
}

/* Checked controls use the same opaque inverse treatment as primary buttons. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(.ui-checkbox.ui-checkbox, .ui-radio.ui-radio, .ui-switch.ui-switch)[data-checked] {
  background-image: none;
}

/* Opaque headers share their parent's material instead of hiding it. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
  .ui-code-block-header.ui-code-block-header,
  .ui-table-head.ui-table-head,
  .ui-scroll-corner.ui-scroll-corner
) {
  background-color: var(--ui-pack-contained-surface-bg, var(--ui-surface));
}

/* Semantic fills/text stay calibrated; their glow follows the foreground tone. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-attachment.ui-attachment:where([data-status='error']) {
  background-image: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}
:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(.ui-badge.ui-badge, .ui-alert.ui-alert, .ui-status-message.ui-status-message) {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-tonal-shadow, none);
}
:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
  .ui-alert.ui-alert,
  .ui-status-message.ui-status-message,
  .ui-badge.ui-badge:where([data-variant='secondary'], [data-variant='outline']),
  .ui-bubble.ui-bubble:where(:not([data-variant='secondary']))
) {
  background-image: var(--ui-pack-tonal-image, none);
}
/* Inverse fills stay opaque: lighting must not lower foreground contrast. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-bubble.ui-bubble {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-control-shadow, none);
}
:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-tooltip.ui-tooltip {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-surface-shadow, var(--ui-shadow));
}

/* Action glow stays independent of focus/error feedback. The extra class keeps
 * pressed effects above base state rules regardless of lazy stylesheet order. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-button.ui-button.ui-button[data-variant='primary']:where(
    :not(:disabled, [data-disabled], [aria-disabled='true'], [data-loading], [aria-invalid='true'])
  ) {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-action-shadow, none);
}

:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-button.ui-button.ui-button[data-variant='primary']:where(
    :not(:disabled, [data-disabled], [aria-disabled='true'], [data-loading], [aria-invalid='true'])
  ):is(:not([data-ui-state]):hover, [data-ui-state='hover']) {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-action-hover-shadow, var(--ui-pack-action-shadow, none));
}

:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-button.ui-button.ui-button[data-variant='primary']:where(
    :not(:disabled, [data-disabled], [aria-disabled='true'], [data-loading], [aria-invalid='true'])
  ):is(:not([data-ui-state]):active, [data-ui-state='pressed']) {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-pressed-shadow, inset 0 1px 2px #00000018);
}

:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-button.ui-button.ui-button[data-variant='secondary']:where(
    :not(
      :disabled,
      [data-disabled],
      [aria-disabled='true'],
      [aria-busy='true'],
      [data-loading],
      [aria-invalid='true']
    )
  ):is(:not([data-ui-state]):active, [data-ui-state='pressed']) {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-pressed-shadow, inset 0 1px 2px #00000018);
}

:where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
  .ui-tabs-tab.ui-tabs-tab[data-active],
  .ui-navigation-trigger.ui-navigation-trigger[data-active],
  .ui-navigation-trigger.ui-navigation-trigger[data-popup-open],
  .ui-menubar-trigger.ui-menubar-trigger[data-popup-open],
  .ui-sidebar-item.ui-sidebar-item[aria-current],
  .ui-checkbox.ui-checkbox[data-checked],
  .ui-radio.ui-radio[data-checked],
  .ui-switch.ui-switch[data-checked],
  .ui-toggle.ui-toggle[data-pressed],
  .ui-toggle-group-item.ui-toggle-group-item[data-pressed],
  .ui-pagination-button.ui-pagination-button[aria-current='page'],
  .ui-accordion-trigger.ui-accordion-trigger[data-open],
  .ui-time-picker-grid button[aria-pressed='true'],
  .ui-time-picker-apply.ui-time-picker-apply,
  .ui-header-navigation [aria-current='page'],
  .ui-slider:where(:not([data-disabled], [aria-invalid='true'])) .ui-slider-indicator,
  .ui-stepper:where(:not([data-disabled]))
    .ui-stepper-item:where([data-status='current'])
    .ui-stepper-button:where(:not(:disabled, [aria-disabled='true']))
    .ui-stepper-marker
):where(
  :not(
    :disabled,
    [data-disabled],
    [aria-disabled='true'],
    [aria-invalid='true'],
    [aria-busy='true'],
    [data-loading],
    [data-ui-state='error'],
    [data-ui-state='disabled'],
    [data-ui-state='loading']
  )
) {
  box-shadow: var(--ui-pack-active-shadow, none);
}

/* Color feedback can transition; expensive blur/glow effects do not. */
:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-button.ui-button,
:where([data-moru-registry]) .ui-tabs-tab.ui-tabs-tab {
  transition-property: background-color, border-color, color, transform;
}

/* Reset recipe variables on painted components, not their ThemeScope whose
 * inline token variables must remain intact. Error/disabled styles keep ownership.
 */
@supports not ((backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px))) {
  :where([data-moru-registry]) :where(
    .ui-card,
    .ui-dialog,
    .ui-toast,
    .ui-command,
    .ui-menu,
    .ui-popover,
    .ui-select-popup,
    .ui-combobox-popup,
    .ui-alert-dialog,
    .ui-sheet,
    .ui-drawer,
    .ui-navigation-popup,
    .ui-hover-card,
    .ui-sidebar-mobile-panel,
    .ui-sidebar,
    .ui-calendar,
    .ui-code-block,
    .ui-collapsible,
    .ui-scroll-area,
    .ui-resizable-group,
    .ui-table-scroll,
    .ui-message-scroller,
    .ui-attachment,
    .ui-header,
    .ui-footer,
    .ui-input,
    .ui-textarea,
    .ui-select,
    .ui-native-select,
    .ui-date-picker-trigger,
    .ui-input-group,
    .ui-combobox,
    .ui-number-input-group,
    .ui-multi-select,
    .ui-time-picker-control,
    .ui-button,
    .ui-checkbox,
    .ui-radio,
    .ui-switch,
    .ui-file-input input[type='file'],
    .ui-slider-thumb,
    .ui-slider-indicator,
    .ui-tabs-list,
    .ui-toggle-group,
    .ui-toggle-group-item,
    .ui-toggle,
    .ui-kbd,
    .ui-item,
    .ui-context-menu-trigger,
    .ui-sidebar-mobile-trigger,
    .ui-menubar,
    .ui-pagination-button,
    .ui-stepper-marker,
    .ui-accordion-trigger,
    .ui-time-picker-grid button,
    .ui-time-picker-apply,
    .ui-header-navigation [aria-current],
    .ui-tooltip,
    .ui-bubble,
    .ui-badge,
    .ui-alert,
    .ui-status-message
  ) {
    --ui-pack-surface-bg: var(--ui-surface, #fff);
    --ui-pack-surface-image: none;
    --ui-pack-surface-filter: none;
    --ui-pack-surface-shadow: var(--ui-shadow, none);
    --ui-pack-sidebar-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-control-image: none;
    --ui-pack-control-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-contained-surface-bg: var(--ui-surface);
    --ui-pack-tonal-image: none;
    --ui-pack-tonal-shadow: none;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) {
  :where([data-moru-registry]) :where(
    .ui-card,
    .ui-dialog,
    .ui-toast,
    .ui-command,
    .ui-menu,
    .ui-popover,
    .ui-select-popup,
    .ui-combobox-popup,
    .ui-alert-dialog,
    .ui-sheet,
    .ui-drawer,
    .ui-navigation-popup,
    .ui-hover-card,
    .ui-sidebar-mobile-panel,
    .ui-sidebar,
    .ui-calendar,
    .ui-code-block,
    .ui-collapsible,
    .ui-scroll-area,
    .ui-resizable-group,
    .ui-table-scroll,
    .ui-message-scroller,
    .ui-attachment,
    .ui-header,
    .ui-footer,
    .ui-input,
    .ui-textarea,
    .ui-select,
    .ui-native-select,
    .ui-date-picker-trigger,
    .ui-input-group,
    .ui-combobox,
    .ui-number-input-group,
    .ui-multi-select,
    .ui-time-picker-control,
    .ui-button,
    .ui-checkbox,
    .ui-radio,
    .ui-switch,
    .ui-file-input input[type='file'],
    .ui-slider-thumb,
    .ui-slider-indicator,
    .ui-tabs-list,
    .ui-toggle-group,
    .ui-toggle-group-item,
    .ui-toggle,
    .ui-kbd,
    .ui-item,
    .ui-context-menu-trigger,
    .ui-sidebar-mobile-trigger,
    .ui-menubar,
    .ui-pagination-button,
    .ui-stepper-marker,
    .ui-accordion-trigger,
    .ui-time-picker-grid button,
    .ui-time-picker-apply,
    .ui-header-navigation [aria-current],
    .ui-tooltip,
    .ui-bubble,
    .ui-badge,
    .ui-alert,
    .ui-status-message
  ) {
    --ui-pack-surface-bg: var(--ui-surface, #fff);
    --ui-pack-surface-image: none;
    --ui-pack-surface-filter: none;
    --ui-pack-surface-shadow: var(--ui-shadow, none);
    --ui-pack-sidebar-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-control-image: none;
    --ui-pack-control-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-contained-surface-bg: var(--ui-surface);
    --ui-pack-tonal-image: none;
    --ui-pack-tonal-shadow: none;
  }
}

@media (forced-colors: active) {
  :where([data-moru-registry]) :where(
    .ui-card,
    .ui-dialog,
    .ui-toast,
    .ui-command,
    .ui-menu,
    .ui-popover,
    .ui-select-popup,
    .ui-combobox-popup,
    .ui-alert-dialog,
    .ui-sheet,
    .ui-drawer,
    .ui-navigation-popup,
    .ui-hover-card,
    .ui-sidebar-mobile-panel,
    .ui-sidebar,
    .ui-calendar,
    .ui-code-block,
    .ui-collapsible,
    .ui-scroll-area,
    .ui-resizable-group,
    .ui-table-scroll,
    .ui-message-scroller,
    .ui-attachment,
    .ui-header,
    .ui-footer,
    .ui-input,
    .ui-textarea,
    .ui-select,
    .ui-native-select,
    .ui-date-picker-trigger,
    .ui-input-group,
    .ui-combobox,
    .ui-number-input-group,
    .ui-multi-select,
    .ui-time-picker-control,
    .ui-button,
    .ui-checkbox,
    .ui-radio,
    .ui-switch,
    .ui-file-input input[type='file'],
    .ui-slider-thumb,
    .ui-slider-indicator,
    .ui-tabs-list,
    .ui-toggle-group,
    .ui-toggle-group-item,
    .ui-toggle,
    .ui-kbd,
    .ui-item,
    .ui-context-menu-trigger,
    .ui-sidebar-mobile-trigger,
    .ui-menubar,
    .ui-pagination-button,
    .ui-stepper-marker,
    .ui-accordion-trigger,
    .ui-time-picker-grid button,
    .ui-time-picker-apply,
    .ui-header-navigation [aria-current],
    .ui-tooltip,
    .ui-bubble,
    .ui-badge,
    .ui-alert,
    .ui-status-message,
    .ui-tabs-tab,
    .ui-navigation-trigger,
    .ui-menubar-trigger,
    .ui-sidebar-item
  ) {
    --ui-pack-surface-image: none;
    --ui-pack-surface-filter: none;
    --ui-pack-surface-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-sidebar-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-control-image: none;
    --ui-pack-control-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-contained-surface-bg: var(--ui-surface);
    --ui-pack-tonal-image: none;
    --ui-pack-tonal-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-action-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-action-hover-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-pressed-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-active-shadow: none;
    --ui-pack-selection-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent;
    --ui-pack-highlight-shadow: none;
  }
  :where([data-moru-registry]) :is(
    .ui-card.ui-card,
    .ui-dialog.ui-dialog,
    .ui-toast.ui-toast,
    .ui-command.ui-command,
    .ui-menu.ui-menu,
    .ui-popover.ui-popover,
    .ui-select-popup.ui-select-popup,
    .ui-combobox-popup.ui-combobox-popup,
    .ui-alert-dialog.ui-alert-dialog,
    .ui-sheet.ui-sheet,
    .ui-drawer.ui-drawer,
    .ui-navigation-popup.ui-navigation-popup,
    .ui-hover-card.ui-hover-card,
    .ui-sidebar-mobile-panel.ui-sidebar-mobile-panel,
    .ui-sidebar.ui-sidebar,
    .ui-calendar.ui-calendar,
    .ui-code-block.ui-code-block,
    .ui-collapsible.ui-collapsible,
    .ui-scroll-area.ui-scroll-area,
    .ui-resizable-group.ui-resizable-group,
